difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the kernel of the change of base field map on Chow groups along an algebraic extension consists of torsion classes (statement lines 2384-2390). The proof (proof lines 2391-2400) reduces to a finite extension and computes the composite of flat pullback with pushforward as multiplication by the degree of the extension. H2: a short proof whose substitution is directly checkable by the reader.
